source_kind: derived aggregate over retained FMCSA Company Census evidence
ownership: FMCSA owns the source fields; this publisher owns only the governed aggregate transformation.
allowed_use: local replay of the pinned retained FMCSA release
prohibited_use: adding records to generic business, entity, site, category, or export totals
publishing names, addresses, USDOT numbers, docket numbers, or other record identifiers
treating nonexclusive roles or classes as an exclusive partition
claiming current operation, unique businesses, storefronts, address deliverability, or nationwide completeness
retention: Retain immutable aggregate releases with exact dependency pins until approved removal.
redistribution: Allowed only as governed aggregates with FMCSA attribution, source timestamps, privacy warnings, and claim limitations.
personal_data_handling: Aggregate counts only; names, addresses, USDOT/docket numbers, and record identifiers are prohibited.
privacy_warning: FMCSA principal offices may be home-based and registrant names may identify individual proprietors; only aggregates may be exported.
attribution: Source: U.S. DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration Company Census retained release.
